name: Hobgoblin Captain

traits.name: Martial Advantage
traits.description: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 ft. of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hobgoblin makes three melee attacks: two with its glaive and one with its longsword. Or it makes two ranged attacks with its javelin.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d10) slashing damage, or 5 (1d10) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.description: For 1 minute, the hobgoblin can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 ft. of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the hobgoblin. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the hobgoblin is incapacitated.

description: A hobgoblin captain commands squads of hobgoblin soldiers, barking orders that bolster their morale and coordinating their attacks against isolated foes.
